class_name: 限定-そのもの-ニカギッテ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Fences a case off as the only one that qualifies: 本日に限り and 会員の方に限り in notices, 本日に限っての特別価格 before a noun. Unlike だけ, に限って also carries the exasperated on-that-one-occasion reading (急いでいる朝に限って電車が遅れる), and in 〜に限って〜ない it voices a refusal to believe ill of someone trusted (うちの子に限って), stating conviction rather than fact. It attaches to a noun, so a time span needs a head like 日 or 時.

examples.ruby: 本日[ほんじつ]に限[かぎ]っての特別価格[とくべつかかく]ですので、お早[はや]めにどうぞ。
examples.english: This is a today-only price, so don't wait.

examples.ruby: 急[いそ]いでいる朝[あさ]に限[かぎ]って、電車[でんしゃ]が遅[おく]れる。
examples.english: The train runs late precisely on the mornings I'm in a hurry.

examples.ruby: うちの子[こ]に限[かぎ]って、そんなことをするはずがない。
examples.english: Not my child. There's no way he'd do a thing like that.
